summary: @or-sdk/idw-public preinstall executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's preinstall script (`setup.mjs`, invoked via `node setup.mjs` on `npm install`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then runs it against the bundled `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`). `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated file (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) using shuffled string-array rotation (`WV8StW`), a ~1600-element hex lookup table (`n7gIxM`), hex-mangled `_0xNNNN` identifiers, a custom decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and multiple `with(...)` blocks that defeat normal static parsing. The package's advertised purpose is a small REST client (`IdwPublic` — channels/skills/vCard) fully implemented by the plain `dist/cjs/*.js` files; `math_init.js` has no functional relationship to that SDK. The alternate-runtime execution pattern (installing Bun solely to run a sibling obfuscated script) moves the payload outside Node's resolved-module surface where standard scanners inspect code, and it fires automatically on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
